caseNameFull: Mann v. Oklahoma Alexander v. Texas Marek v. Singletary, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections Hooks v. Oklahoma Hallford v. Alabama Code v. Louisiana Beuke v. Ohio Chambers v. Texas Buell v. Ohio Conklin v. Zant, Warden

opinions.text: Ct. Crim. App. Okla.; Ct. Crim. App. Tex.; Sup. Ct. Fla.; Ct. Crim. App. Okla.; Ct. Crim. App. Ala.; Sup. Ct. La.; Sup. Ct. Ohio; Ct. Crim. App. Tex.; Sup. Ct. Ohio; and Sup. Ct. Ga. Certiorari denied.

opinions.author: Blackmun
opinions.text:
Justice Blackmun,

dissenting.

Adhering to my view that the death penalty cannot be imposed fairly within the constraints of our Constitution, see my dissent in Callins v. Collins, 510 U. S. 1141, 1143 (1994), I would grant certiorari and vacate the death sentences in these cases.
